answer: Gate admission with a sealed-bid slot auction called raven: an agent must hold one raven slot or its transactions are invalid, and the clearing price is set by the marginal bidder, so doubled demand doubles price. Slots burn on use and cannot transfer or re-key mid-epoch, so one deposit cannot spawn many identities. At dawn the ledger voids unsold slots and reopens the bridge auction, pricing admission per identity per round: N puppets each pay the full clearing price, no bulk discount, while an honest agent buys one slot once. Attacker cost grows linearly in sybils.
